headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings pitched. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and 4 at-bats.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed right-handed pitcher Will Klein on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The San Francisco Giants placed catcher Jesus Rodriguez on the 10-day injured list with right elbow neuritis. The Seattle Mariners placed right fielder Luke Raley on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, with a left forearm strain. The Minnesota Twins transferred right-handed pitcher Mike Paredes from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a left oblique strain.

The Atlanta Braves bolstered their outfield with the acquisition of center fielder Lane Thomas in a trade with the Kansas City Royals. The Seattle Mariners traded right-handed pitcher Luis Castillo to the Chicago White Sox for right-handed pitcher Seranthony Domínguez, catcher Boston Smith, right fielder Nolan Jones, and cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings pitched. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 2 RBIs, and 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert pitched 7 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 6 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Chicago White Sox 1-0, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 6.0 innings, striking out 10 batters and allowing no earned runs. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a single that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the offense. Sanoja hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Dodgers RHP Will Klein Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Will Klein has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Outfield with Lane Thomas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired center fielder Lane Thomas in a trade with the Kansas City Royals. Thomas joins the Braves after being dealt along with left-hander Bailey Falter in exchange for left-hander Carter Holton and right-hander Lucas Braun.
